Charu Sharma vs The State Of Rajasthan ... on 23 August, 2024 
Bench: Manindra Mohan Shrivastava, Madan Gopal Vyas
[2024:Rj-Jd:35047-Db]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
 D.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 11321/2021
1. Charu Sharma W/o Shri Himanshu Sharma, Aged About 38
 Years, 5-D 35, Sector-5, Maharshi Dayanand Park, Jai Narayan
 Vyas Colony, Bikaner, District Bikaner (Raj.). 
2. Lalit Narayan Purohit S/o Shri Roop Narayan Purohit, Aged  About 49 Years, Manawat Purohit Ki Gali, Lalani Vyaso Ka  Chowk, Bikaner, District Bikaner (Raj.). 
 ----Petitioners  Versus 1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through Its Principal Secretary, Urban  Development And Housing Department, Having Office At Food  Building, Secretariat, Government Of Rajasthan, Jaipur,
 302005. 
2. The Petroleum And Explosives Safety Organisation, Through  Its Chief Explosive Controller Having Registered Office At A-  Block, 5Th Floor, Cgo Complex, Seminary Hills, Nagpur,
 440006.
3. Rajasthan State Pollution Control Board, Through Its Chairman  Having Registered Office At 4, Jhalana Institutional Area,
 Jhalana Doongari, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302004 4. Chairman, Urban Improvement Trust, Bikaner Having Office At  Rath Khana Colony, Bikaner (Raj.) Pin 334001 5. District Collector And District Magistrate, Bikaner. 
6. Mr. Gaurav Gautam S/o Shri Anurag Gautam, 343-A Lane No.
 10, Barkat Nagar, Tonk, Dist. Jaipur, Pin 302015. 
7. Mr. Rakesh Mordiya S/o Parsaram Mordiya, G-1 Plot No. B-60,
 University Road, Bapu Nagar, Lal Kothi, Udaipur. 
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ankur Mathur For Respondent(s) : Mr. Ayush Gehlot for Mr. Rajesh Panwar,

 AGC for Mr. S.S. Ladrecha, AAG  Mr. Chirag Kalani for Mr. B.S. Sandhu for  respondent Nos.6 and 7  Mr. S.S. Rathore, AAG  (Downloaded on 28/08/2024 at 08:39:03 PM)
 [2024:RJ-JD:35047-DB] (2 of 3) [CW-11321/2021 ] 
 HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. MANINDRA MOHAN SHRIVASTAVA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MADAN GOPAL VYAS Order 23/08/2024 As per office report, service of notice upon respondent No.7 is received unserved. Mr. Chirag Kalani for Mr. B.S. Sandhu accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.7. 
Service is thus complete. 
The grant of NOC to private respondents is under challenge on various grounds. 
Learned counsel for the respondent No.7 places before this Court an order dated 21.07.2023 passed by the learned Single Judge of this Court in SBCWP No.9769/2021 (Manoj K. Kamra vs. Indian Oil Corporation Limited & Ors.), wherein the order dated 22.06.2021 of the Chief Town Planner,
Rajasthan issuing NOC for conversion of land followed by order dated 25.06.2021 of the UIT,
Bikaner granting land conversion approval in favour of the private respondents were under challenge. The order further refers to Letter of Intent ('LOI') dated 14.09.2020. 
In this present petition, NOC dated 28.07.2021 issued by the District Magistrate, Bikaner is under challenge. 
Since the issue has already been dealt with by the learned Single Judge of this Court and certain remedies have been provided to the petitioners therein, we are not inclined to go through the merits of the case and leave the matter to be examined by the appropriate authority. The petitioners herein may also approach the authorities challenging various orders which were assailed in the aforesaid writ petition as those orders have [2024:RJ-JD:35047-DB] (3 of 3) [CW-11321/2021] direct bearing on the issue of the validity of LOI of the NOC, which is under challenge. 
With these observations, this writ petition is disposed of. The appropriate authority if approached by the petitioners, should take decision on the objection within a period of three months. 
(MADAN GOPAL VYAS),J (MANINDRA MOHAN SHRIVASTAVA),CJ 26-Taruna/-
